svg.aria-label: Bio: Julien DeWolfe, Software Engineering student at the University of Ottawa, started making games in Blender's node-based engine at age 9, then Unity, C#, game jams and networking rabbit holes. Currently an intern at gadget.dev.

g.text: I'm Julien DeWolfe, a Software Engineering student at the University of Ottawa who started
making games in Blender's node-based engine at age 9. That turned into Unity, C#, game jams,
networking rabbit holes, and eventually a fascination with systems and engineering in general.
Right now I'm an intern at gadget.dev while finishing my degree.
